architecture.hostLifetime: Map host/panel remain outside route-rendered #content. One Leaflet map instance per loaded page.
architecture.mount: Reentrant mount uses existing instance; invalidate size and sync overlays instead of destroying/recreating map.
architecture.viewport: Keep center and zoom across menu/criteria/language/theme changes. Explicit navigate/back/home/focus may fit or setView; ordinary sync never refits.
architecture.persistenceLimit: Viewport and map-layer toggles are in-memory within this loaded page, not a saved cross-reload map session.
architecture.stateSeparation: Viewport, focused feature, visual layers and basemap are personal view state. Applied criteria and POI data require their separate explicit commit action.

draftComparison.before: evaluate(Y.criteria), eligible IDs in current brand+scope context
draftComparison.after: evaluate(draft) only on criteria route; otherwise same applied evaluator

layers.meaning: after eligible also present before whose eligible rank changed

displayedCounters: changed eligible ranks in current navigation
draftComparison.layerReset: On leaving criteria or entering another noncriteria route, return to eligible; target/activity routes choose their contextual rows.
draftComparison.invalidDraft: Retain last valid map result with explicit invalid-criteria status; never render empty evaluation as0 demand/0 matches.
draftComparison.eligibilityVsRanking: Weight-only changes may reorder existing eligible IDs but must not change Demand/tier/pattern/eligible membership.
draftComparison.apply: One valid explicit Apply commits a changed criteria revision and one event. Map gestures and preview do not call emitEvent.
draftComparison.navigationCounts: Evaluate the fixed national context first, then filter/distinct fine UUIDs by current navigation for counts/layers. A smaller map view never rebases percentile cutoffs or creates an aggregate district Demand score.

visualSemantics.theme: Identical approved analytical HEX in light/dark. Meaning and direction unchanged; labels/neutral backplates/borders aid readability.
visualSemantics.neutral: No confirmed qualifying match in this view, not measured Demand0.
visualSemantics.unresolved: Separate status, dashed cues and counts at the current hierarchy grain. Counts summarize reporting areas and are not POI coordinates.
visualSemantics.opacity: Country/province/district analytical choropleth layers use fillOpacity1/opacity1 with exact native HEX. The selected location view is a selection outline, fill=false, not a transformed analytical fill. Basemap image treatment stays only on tile pane.

geometry.polygon: Only source/verified Polygon or MultiPolygon from available source geometry; not independent statutory boundary certification.
geometry.extent: Finite ordered EPSG:3857 source extent converted to geographic view bounds; dashed and unfilled. It is not an area boundary or eligibility join.
geometry.detailedZoom: Navigation level, not arbitrary zoom, controls choropleth grain: country districts; province/district source fine polygons; selected location adds O/C/U.
geometry.focus: Explicit focus may use polygon bounds or source extent; unavailable geometry must retain an honest label.
geometry.POIJoin: Source-assigned fine reporting UUID and original coordinates remain separate evidence. Unassigned valid coordinates may be shown when inside the selected source display polygon by a view predicate only. Keep original areaId unassigned; do not alter aggregate membership, official allocation or administrative evidence.

unverified.meaning: Unverified/to verify; not confirmed unbranded station or verified product/function

markers.labels: Keep text/title/accessible labels, not color alone.

visualSemantics.choroplethColor: Best confirmed qualifying Yolk tier among displayed fine-area rows at the current hierarchy grain. Country renders district summaries; province and district render fine areas. It is not a percentile, weighted ranking, measured demand or investment score for the polygon.

selectedFineView.interior: Transparent: fill=false for selected fine-location view; retain basemap visibility.
selectedFineView.cue: Highlight verified boundary/label/tier status only; no muted data-fill opacity.
selectedFineView.coarseChoropleth: Country district and province/district fine-area choropleths retain native exact full-opacity analytical colours.

basemaps.instanceAndViewport: Changing basemap replaces only the tile layer and preserves instance/center/zoom.

simplified.presentation: Muted/grayscale tile pane; separate light/dark visual treatment; analytical overlays unchanged.

detailed.presentation: Detailed road/name tiles; dark visual treatment restricted to tile pane.

satellite.provider: ESA WorldCover / Copernicus Sentinel-2 2021 via Terrascope
satellite.limitation: Historical contextual imagery, not present-day parcel/entrance/operation evidence. Higher display zoom does not add source detail.

basemaps.providerAvailability: External network-dependent tiles; failure does not invalidate available evidence overlays and is not interpreted as absence.

focusAndForms.routeFocus: New place/POI detail may explicitly navigate to its verified fine-area context and focus once. Repeated same detail render never repeatedly refits; unavailable parent links do not invent a hierarchy.
focusAndForms.asyncFocus: Capture focus ticket + criteriaContextKey + route before awaiting source points. Abort stale requests after any changed captured state.
focusAndForms.formRetention: Same route hash and criteria context rerender captures/restores text/select values, province selector, focused field and text selection.
focusAndForms.formScopeLimit: Do not carry a form draft into a different route/context/branch. Photo module holds its own local draft state; file input value is not reconstructed.
focusAndForms.mutations: Pan/zoom, layer toggle, basemap change and selecting/focusing a feature do not mutate applied criteria, source aggregates or POI records; no team event.
focusAndForms.productionGate: Server optimistic-lock protection and mutation authorization remain separate from visual form restoration.
focusAndForms.asyncPOISave: Capture contextKey, route, record ID and revision before awaiting photo processing; verify all again before mutation. On stale completion abort without old-context mutation, event, or replacing/rolling back current-context POIs.

dataAndFailureStates.loading: Retain viewpoint and hierarchy with explicit switching-data status; clear stale source labels/results while context changes.
dataAndFailureStates.loadError: Clear old-brand result layers, neutral/dashed province context and industry-unavailable status; never describe old data as new selected context.
dataAndFailureStates.pointError: Say inventory unavailable; do not infer zero branches.
dataAndFailureStates.geometryError: Use explicitly labeled available source extent; do not invent polygon.
dataAndFailureStates.provinceError: Keep available place/pin context with explicit province-boundary error.
dataAndFailureStates.tileError: Keep data overlays and explicit basemap failure status.
dataAndFailureStates.unknownSupply: Preserve model possiblePatterns/intervals and scope uncertainty, never turn into0.
dataAndFailureStates.parentCrosswalkError: Keep unmatched areas/pins explicitly unresolved; do not allocate them to a district using a name or extent.
dataAndFailureStates.districtGeometryError: Show available navigation/list evidence and a source-geometry limitation; do not fall back silently to province grain.

renderLimits.meaning: Display caps after viewport/context filtering, not inventory totals.
renderLimits.disclosure: Shown/available counts and pin cap near map; zoom/filter to inspect fewer records.
renderLimits.productionDirection: For larger point inventory use verified server spatial queries or clustering with disclosed counts; do not fabricate point positions.

acceptance.assertion: One Leaflet instance survives all menu and repeated mount calls; viewport is not refit by ordinary sync.
Criteria draft map equals model before/after eligible sets; invalid draft is paused with message; Apply stays explicit.
All77 province outline codes,928 native district polygons and7,954 fine reporting UUIDs reconcile; choropleth uses current hierarchy grain and exact li.demand classes across themes.
Real polygon and source extent distinguish solid/dashed; no centroid/extent used to fabricate POI or legal membership.
Supply tab/brand/search/area filters and O/C/U visibility affect actual valid viewport pins; cap and counts disclosed.
Context switch loading/error does not show stale own/competitor labels or describe old data as new.
Late focus cannot move map after navigation/brand change/drag/new focus; same-form rerender preserves text and cursor.
Basemap changes keep viewport; satellite year/resolution/native zoom and provider attribution explicit.
Map gestures and preview produce no criteria/POI mutation, analytical recomputation of national cohort or team event.
Review actual TH/EN mobile/desktop light/dark rendering, sticky visibility, popup near edges, keyboard/touch focus and errors.
Country choropleth grain is district; province/district grain is verified fine reporting areas; selected fine area exposes relevant original-coordinate O/C/U points.
Hierarchy inclusion and district tier summaries use verified parent IDs/crosswalk, not names/bbox/centroids; nationwide cohort and cutoffs remain unchanged.
Drill/back/breadcrumb/personal navigation do not emit team events; ordinary route/criteria sync preserves current hierarchy and viewport.
Record exact district/fine polygon and parent-crosswalk coverage. Missing geometry is visible; never claim complete geometry from complete metric rows.
Selected location interior is transparent (fill=false); boundary/label/status and O/C/U remain visible over basemap. Coarse ordinal analytical choropleths stay native exact/full-opacity.
Unassigned coordinate-in-source-polygon matches are view-only; source assignment and supply aggregates remain unchanged. Photo-await stale completions cannot mutate another context.

verification.scope: Model/source and local DOM/Leaflet-adapter assertions do not prove actual browser pan/touch, label fit or external tile availability.
verification.browserEvidence: Attach actual release review evidence; this contract does not claim visual or production acceptance by itself.

productionRemaining: server spatial fetch and scalable clustering
verified hierarchical geometry and crosswalk coverage where missing
operational freshness and fine-area POI assignment review
native MVT/spatial tiling optimization if approved; current runtime uses local GeoJSON and no z0 completeness claim
claimLimit: Location-context screening and team workflow, not measured customers/sales/borrowing, parcel feasibility or permission to open a branch.

hierarchy.status: Implemented controller with source projection frozen on2026-10-04; automated model/geometry results and browser review are separate evidence.

country.click: Click a district polygon to open its verified parent province; country choropleth remains district-grain.

province.click: Select the verified parent district and drill into it.

district.click: Select one available fine reporting area.

fineAreaDefault.scope: Use the existing reporting UUID grain. Optional administrative subdistrict views require an explicit crosswalk; do not equate a LAO with a tambon.

hierarchy.districtAggregation: Best confirmed eligible fine-area qualifyingTier among displayed rows with a verified parent district crosswalk. This is a summary of screened fine areas, not a newly evaluated district or a district percentile.
hierarchy.parentAssignment: Use source parent IDs/codes or a verified, provenance/versioned spatial-intersection crosswalk. Support multi-district reporting areas explicitly. Never infer parents from names, municipality code parsing, bbox, centroid or viewport visibility.
hierarchy.finePOIGate: Only selected location view shows relevant O/C/U records. Include source-assigned fine UUIDs and unassigned valid coordinates that pass the actual-source-polygon view predicate, explicitly view-only. Existing branch editor may focus one original coordinate with boundary-unresolved label; never invent an area UUID.
hierarchy.coverage: 928 native district polygons; 7,954 native fine reporting polygons in77 province files. All fine reporting UUIDs have a source polygon-overlap display crosswalk;45 relate to multiple districts. Coverage does not certify statutory boundary, vintage or independent open licence.
hierarchy.missingGeometry: Keep an explicit unavailable-geometry message and available list navigation. A dashed source extent is a fit aid only, never a substitute administrative boundary.

location.view: Selected fine area and its verified source geometry or labelled source extent; then show relevant O/C/U records with usable original coordinates.

hierarchy.countPolicy: Reporting UUID is the national count key. Multi-district membership can appear in more than one district summary; dedupe by fine reporting UUID for national/province counts. Never sum district relation edges as national area count.

crosswalkMethod.calculation: Planar EPSG:4326 polygon area ratio; display relationship only, not surveyed area
crosswalkMethod.multiDistrict: Retain every district meeting the threshold; offer explicit district choice, never collapse to a municipality-code guess
crosswalkMethod.limit: Not statutory affiliation; boundary vintage and legal status are not independently verified

api.mount: mount({onProvince,onArea,onPoi,onNavigate}) reuses the existing instance. onNavigate(path) receives the actual navigation path; legacy onProvince is used only if onNavigate is absent.
api.sync: sync() updates current navigation/context layers without generic refit.

path.districtName: optional district label; not an identity join key

navigate.meaning: Explicit hierarchy/view action. Use actual source IDs and verified crosswalk; retain multi-district membership.

api.back: back() explicitly moves to the parent hierarchy view.
api.getNavigation: getNavigation() returns {level, provinceCode, districtId, districtName, areaId} for the current in-memory view.
api.areaMatchesNavigation: areaMatchesNavigation(areaOrId) uses verified fine reporting/parent crosswalk membership for current navigation.
api.navigationLabel: navigationLabel() uses current TH/EN and the source catalogue; the controller does not require a language argument.
api.focusArea: focusArea(id) opens/fits an available fine reporting area with honest polygon/extent coverage.
api.focusPoi: focusPoi(id) is explicit focus within the applicable fine-area context; stale async tickets abort.
api.home: home() resets to country without itself calling a callback. Home UI/back/breadcrumb use onNavigate; explicit focusArea/focusPoi routes do not emit onNavigate.
api.setBasemap: setBasemap(id) changes only tile layer and preserves current viewpoint.
api.setLayer: setLayer(id) changes before/after/rank visualization without applying criteria.
api.poiMatchesNavigation: poiMatchesNavigation(p) uses assigned fine reporting UUID or validated source districtId; never an extent or inferred point position.

sourceProjection.crosswalkAreaCalculation: Planar EPSG:4326 polygon area ratio, display hierarchy only; not surveyed surface area.

displaySimplificationDegrees.exception: Source components retained unsimplified where a simplified projection would invalidate topology.

sourceProjection.verificationLimit: Source projection validity/coverage checks passed as recorded in boundary provenance; model/DOM adapter, actual browser review and production evidence remain separate.

geometryValidation.scope: Published source display projection and crosswalk checks, not statutory/vintage/browser certification

topologyRepairs.method: Shapely2.1.2 make_valid; retain polygonal components; discard collapsed zero-area linework
topologyRepairs.displayValidity: Topology-preserving simplify, then verify; use valid unsimplified source components if simplify invalidates topology
topologyRepairs.metricIsolation: Do not replace original metric values/base.areaSqm denominators with projected or repaired geometry area.

payload.fineLoadPolicy: Lazy load selected province files; do not preload all77 fine-geometry files.

supplyRelative.countMode: optional; previously saved count contexts remain unchanged until explicit user commit
supplyRelative.relativePolicy: One adjustable raw source denominator per preset. Independent own/competitor median cutoffs use positive observed exact-count national rates; uncertainty bounds excluded. Minimum-sample fallback must be explicit. Never divide by Demand percentile/rank or silently turn missing into0.
